name: verify
description: Deterministic constraint evaluation over already-canonical named relations

arguments.name: dataset
arguments.description: Already-canonical relation file bound as input for the shortcut path

options.name: bind
options.description: Bind a declared relation name to an already-canonical CSV, JSON, JSONL, or Parquet file

options.name: lock
options.description: Verify bound input byte hashes against provided lock membership before rule evaluation

options.name: key
options.description: Arity-1 shortcut convenience for bindings[0].key_fields when authoring did not declare a key

options.name: json
options.description: Emit verify.report.v1 JSON for run outcomes, and JSON for doctor, compile, validate and witness

options.name: out
options.description: compile: write the compiled artifact here (`--output` is a deprecated alias)

options.name: check
options.description: compile: validate authoring without writing an output file

options.name: sample_affected
options.description: Limit human output to the first N localized affected entries per failing rule

options.name: explicit
options.description: run: include raw failing key and cell values (and DuckDB error text) in output. Default output replaces them with opaque redacted:sha256: tokens. Protected profiles should block this flag.

options.name: no_witness
options.description: Suppress local witness ledger recording for this run

options.name: outcome
options.description: witness query/count: keep only records with this outcome (PASS, FAIL or REFUSAL)

options.name: command
options.description: witness query/count: keep only records written by this verify command (run, compile, ...)

options.name: limit
options.description: witness query: return at most the N most recent matching records

options.name: describe
options.description: Print this operator.json (the operator.v1 contract) and exit 0

options.name: schema
options.description: Print verify.report.v1 JSON Schema and exit 0

commands.name: capabilities
commands.description: Print the operator.v1 contract; `verify capabilities --json` is byte-identical in content to `verify --describe`

commands.name: robot-docs
commands.description: Print paste-ready operating notes for agents

commands.name: run
commands.description: Evaluate compiled constraints against one or more named relation bindings

commands.name: compile
commands.description: Compile JSON/YAML or SQL authoring into verify.constraint.v1

commands.name: witness
commands.description: Witness ledger read commands. An empty result is success: exit 0 with `[]` (query), `{"count":0}` (count) or `null` (last)

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Read-only diagnostics (cmdrvl.doctor.v1). Exit 0 healthy, 1 unhealthy, 2 usage error only. `doctor --robot-triage` and `--robot-triage` are deprecated aliases of `doctor triage --json`

0.meaning: PASS / successful read command (an empty witness query prints [] and exits 0)

2.meaning: REFUSAL / CLI error / witness internal error

refusals.message: Cannot read a constraint source, compiled artifact, bound input, or lockfile
Compiled artifact invalid or unrecognized version
The same relation name was bound more than once
A relation the constraints declare was not bound
A --bind names a relation the constraints do not declare
Bound input is not CSV, JSON, JSONL or Parquet
Rule references a field missing from a bound canonical relation
A rule expression does not parse
Key data or a binding's key_fields are invalid
A keyed relation has duplicate keys
A keyed row has no counterpart in the other relation
A query-backed rule failed to execute
Embedded execution received a batch-only rule
A CLI --key conflicts with the authored binding key
Bound input not present in any provided lockfile
Bound input hash differs from the lock member

env_vars.name: EPISTEMIC_WITNESS
env_vars.description: Explicit witness ledger path; overrides the implicit ledger and disables legacy migration

env_vars.name: HOME
env_vars.description: Root of the implicit witness ledger and legacy-path migration

env_vars.name: NO_COLOR
env_vars.description: Accepted for family parity; verify never emits ANSI escape sequences, with or without it

side_effects.notes: run and the arity-1 shortcut append a witness record unless --no-witness; compile writes only with --out; doctor, capabilities, robot-docs, validate and witness read commands never write

pipeline.example_pipeline: profile materialize <raw> > canonical.csv; lock ...; verify run constraints.verify.json --bind input=canonical.csv --lock canonical.lock.json --json

crv1_boundary.input: already-canonical named relations produced upstream by profile's bounded materialization
crv1_boundary.provenance: canonical input and profile provenance rides in lock.v0 profiles[] and pack membership, not verify.report.v1

boundaries: verify evaluates already-canonical named relations produced upstream by profile's bounded materialization
verify never loads profiles, resolves --profile-id, or rewrites headers
canonical input/profile provenance rides in lock.v0 profiles[] and pack membership, not verify.report.v1
assess decides proceed, escalate, or block
